name: 90002 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90002 (Los Angeles) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90002 (Los Angeles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
